self[\"tlayer\"].instance.move(ePoint(98,120))\n self[\"tlayer\"].setZPosition(-6)\nself[\"tlayer\"].instance.resize(eSize(menu_list_size.width() + 22,840))\n\nif \"pager\" not in self:\n \nself[\"pager\"].instance.resize(eSize(menu_list_size.width(), 25))\n\nif \"header\" not in self:\n self[\"header\"] = ScreenHeader()\n self[\"header\"].instance.setBackgroundColor(parseColor(\"md_surface_container_high\"))\n self[\"header\"].instance.move(ePoint(108,56))\n self[\"header\"].titleForeground =
